businessType: B2B SaaS serving construction and engineering firms with AI-powered project planning and risk forecasting. Founded 2018, Series A funding $8M (2023). Current 280 customers, $3.2M ARR, 45% YoY growth.
stage: Growth stage Series A: Monthly recurring revenue $267k, gross margin 68%, CAC $2,100, LTV $28,000 (11-month payback), churn rate 6% quarterly. Burn rate $180k/month. Cash runway 22 months.
ownerGoal: Achieve PMF validation (>10% qualified expansion ARR from existing customers) and Series B readiness within 18 months.
ownerConstraints: Customer concentration: Top 5 customers = 32% of ARR. Loss of any top customer would trigger 15%+ revenue cliff.
Unit economics not yet proven at scale: CAC $2,100 assumes 11-month payback, but that assumes zero expansion and benchmark churn. Actual cohort data still building.
Sales cycle: 4-6 months from prospecting to close. Pipeline visibility limited; forecasting challenging for Series B readiness.
Team constraint: 18 people. Product team small relative to customer support burden from concentrated base.
Market timing: Construction tech adoption accelerating post-COVID, but market still heterogeneous; buyer consolidation pressure increasing.
immediateConcern: Churn accelerating unexpectedly. Q2 quarterly churn was 4%, Q3 was 6%. Simultaneously, expansion ARR (upsells to existing customers) is 8% of revenue but declining relative to new customer acquisition. Net revenue retention ~95% (unhealthy for SaaS). Must understand churn driver before Series B positioning.
